sso.providers.emptyText: Connect an OpenID Connect service such as Keycloak, Authentik or Entra ID. Its buttons then come first on the sign-in page.
sso.providers.name: Provider
sso.providers.moveHint: Drag or Alt+Arrow changes the order of the buttons.
sso.providers.removeText: Remove {name}? Its group mappings go with it. This only works while nobody signs in through it; otherwise pause it.
sso.providers.created: {name} was added. Its button is now on the sign-in page.
sso.providers.paused: {name} is paused. Its people stay, but can no longer sign in through it.
sso.providers.orderChanged: The order of the providers changed.
sso.providers.note: New accounts are created at the first sign-in through a provider, with roles from the group mapping. A paused provider keeps its people, but they can no longer sign in through it.
sso.form.name: Name on the button
sso.form.slugHint: Part of the redirect URI; 1 to 40 characters from a–z, 0–9 and -. Fixed once saved.
sso.form.slugFixed: Part of the redirect URI; it cannot be changed after the provider was created.
sso.form.issuerHint: Kalzit reads the discovery and the keys from it.
sso.form.clientSecretHint: Kept in the vault, never shown again.
sso.form.clientSecretKeep: Kept in the vault. Leave empty to keep it.
sso.form.redirectUri: Redirect URI to enter at the provider
sso.form.redirectUriHint: Enter this address at the provider as an allowed redirect URI.
sso.form.scopesHint: Separated by spaces; openid is always added.
sso.form.createAccounts: Create the account at the first sign-in
sso.form.createAccountsHint: Off: only people with an existing account or an invitation.
sso.form.trustMfaOffHint: Kalzit asks for its own second factor when the account has one or must have one.
sso.form.trustMfaOnHint: Kalzit does not ask when the provider checked several factors.
sso.form.advanced: Advanced: email and name claim, PKCE, email confirmation
sso.form.pkceHint: Recommended; turn it off only for providers that refuse PKCE.
sso.form.trustEmail: The provider’s email counts as confirmed
sso.form.trustEmailHint: Links existing accounts by email address even when the provider does not report it as verified.
sso.form.saveNeedsCheck: Save becomes available once the connection passed a check with these values.
sso.form.checkFirst: Check the connection first; changes to issuer, client or secret need a new check.
sso.form.conflict: Someone changed the provider in the meantime. Saving overwrites their change.
sso.form.checkOk: Connection ok. Discovery read, {keys} keys loaded, client accepted ({ms} ms).
sso.form.checkOkUnsure: Connection ok. Discovery read, {keys} keys loaded; the provider does not say whether it accepts the client ({ms} ms).
sso.form.testWaiting: Waiting for the sign-in in the new window…
sso.outcome.refused: would be refused, as no group matches
sso.outcome.none: would get access to no organization
sso.mappings.emptyText: Map groups at the provider to an organization, a team and a role.
sso.mappings.noProviders: Add a provider first; its groups can then be mapped here.
sso.mappings.groupHint: Exactly as the provider sends it; case matters.
sso.mappings.teamsUnreadable: The teams of this organization cannot be read; the mapping applies without a team.
sso.mappings.idpDecidesHint: Role and membership follow the provider at every sign-in; in Members the role is locked.
sso.mappings.kalzitAddsHint: The group gives a minimum role; admins may give more, and when the group falls away, the membership stays.
sso.mappings.created: Mapping for “{group}” created · applies from the next sign-in.
sso.mappings.changed: Mapping for “{group}” changed · applies from the next sign-in.
sso.mappings.removed: Mapping for “{group}” removed · applies from the next sign-in.
sso.mappings.note: Several groups for the same organization: the highest role wins, teams add up. Mappings never change the break-glass admin and never the last owner of an organization.
sso.unmapped.title: People without a matching group
sso.unmapped.description: Applies to every provider at the first and every later sign-in.
sso.unmapped.defaultRoleHint: Organization and role for people without a matching group, as a minimum role.
sso.unmapped.changedRefuse: People without a matching group are now refused · applies from the next sign-in.
sso.unmapped.changedDefault: People without a matching group now get the default role · applies from the next sign-in.
sso.preview.title: Check mapping
sso.preview.lead: What would apply to a person? Uses the groups of their last sign-in.
sso.preview.noGroups: This person never signed in through a provider.
sso.local.title: Sign-in with local password
sso.local.description: Off: only the break-glass admin still signs in with a password.
sso.local.blocked: Locked until every check under “Checked before turning off” is met.
sso.local.readOnly: kalzit.toml or the environment sets these settings; they cannot be changed here.
sso.local.breakGlassHint: Must be a server admin with a password. Every sign-in with it is in the audit log and mailed to all server admins.
sso.local.form: Password form on the sign-in page
sso.local.formHint: Collapsed: below the SSO buttons on click. Hidden: only at /anmelden/lokal.
sso.local.turnedOff: Password sign-in is off; only the break-glass admin still uses a password.
sso.checks.title: Checked before turning off
sso.checks.lead: Local sign-in only goes off when nobody is locked out.
sso.checks.providerReady: {name} is active and passed its check
sso.checks.providerMissing: No active provider that passed a connection check
sso.checks.breakGlassReady: The break-glass admin is a server admin with a password
sso.checks.selfReady: You yourself can sign in through a provider
sso.checks.selfMissing: You yourself cannot sign in through any provider
sso.checks.passwordOnly: Accounts with only a local password: {count}. These people sign in through a provider afterwards.
